name: lamif
description: Ethiopia's Premier Marketplace & Booking Platform for Tutors and Students (MERN Stack + Three.js)

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm start --prefix lamif-backened" "npm run dev --prefix lamif-frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix lamif-backened && npm install --prefix lamif-frontend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix lamif-frontend && npm run build --prefix lamif-frontend && mkdir -p dist && cp -r lamif-frontend/dist/* dist/
